title: A systematic review on age-related macular degeneration: New insights from multi-omics studies
primary_structural_value: PRISMA flow, study-quality assessment, standardized evidence table, and explicit synthesis of multi-omics studies including causal methods
main_limitation: Restricted to one age-related disease and organized mainly as clinical versus non-clinical evidence

title: A scoping review and proposed workflow for multi-omic rare disease research
primary_structural_value: PCC question, duplicate data charting, critical appraisal, omics-combination map, thematic synthesis, and proposed workflow
main_limitation: Not an aging or causal-evidence review

title: Multi-omics strategies to decode the molecular landscape of cellular senescence
primary_structural_value: Close aging-process scope and a dedicated section on the added value of multi-omics
main_limitation: No reproducible review methods and mostly organized by molecular modality

title: Integrated Multi-Omics for Novel Aging Biomarkers and Antiaging Targets
primary_structural_value: Broad aging scope spanning clocks, biomarkers, integromics, systems biology, and interventions
main_limitation: No systematic methods and catalogues evidence largely by individual omics layer

title: Emerging Omics Approaches in Aging Research
primary_structural_value: Explicit cause-versus-consequence problem, data integration section, and unresolved research questions
main_limitation: Predates much of the current causal multi-omics literature and has no systematic selection method

title: Multiomics of Aging and Aging-Related Diseases
primary_structural_value: Disease-oriented synthesis tables that record omics combinations and principal findings
main_limitation: Mixes aging mechanisms with age-related diseases and has no systematic review method

title: Disentangling causality in brain aging: The complex interplay between glial senescence neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration
primary_structural_value: Organizes causal interpretation using temporal, genetic, interventional, and Bradford Hill evidence
main_limitation: Not a multi-omics systematic review and is limited to brain aging

title: Measuring biological age using omics data
primary_structural_value: Separates omics clock families from critical questions about application, correlation, causation, and validation
main_limitation: Focused on aging clocks rather than causal multi-omics studies

title: Fetal Origins of Adult Disease in 2026: A Systematic Review and Evidence Map of Causal Mechanisms Multi-Omic Programming and Intervention-Ready Targets
primary_structural_value: Combines heterogeneous causal designs, multi-omic evidence, risk-of-bias appraisal, and triangulation in one evidence map
main_limitation: Reviews developmental programming and later disease rather than biological aging processes
